purpose: Human visual audit of the prompt-blind future localizer. This audit may invalidate or qualify the scorer but may not tune its frozen thresholds.
population: All Cosmos canonical and short-paraphrase confirmation episodes, both directions, seeds 6100-6109.
automatic_evidence: The scorer writes one full contact sheet for every episode, covering every replan chunk and all four scored frames in both third-person cameras.

detailed_human_sample.selection_rule: First, middle, and final seed in the already-frozen ordered seed list; selected without reference to semantic labels or closed-loop success.
detailed_human_sample.coverage: Every replan and scored frame in each selected episode.

review_questions: Does the cyan point visibly mark the physical Rubik's cube in each camera?
Does the red point visibly mark the red bowl in each camera?
Do abstentions correspond to visible occlusion, object ambiguity, cross-camera inconsistency, or gross localization error?
Are any certain left/right labels visibly contradicted by the marked object centers?
Is there evidence that the localizer follows a policy prompt rather than image content?
decision_rule: Report errors and examples without altering labels. If gross systematic object confusion appears, semantic results are a no-go and only raw/contact-sheet evidence remains publishable.
